The '''Duhrib Belt''' was a swath of rust-colored [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] that orbited the star in the [[Nah'Malis system]] between the fourth and fifth planets. The asteroids in the belt were widely spaced and tumbled slowly, allowing easy access for medium sized ships. It was exploited by Danoor for ores and raw materials through the use of [[Mining drone/Legends|mining drones]].
